Student fees / institutional support sit on the school (capacity.studentFees, capacity.institutionalSupport, capacity.governmentSupport when split) and on layers.subsidy. Ohio State keeps the $0/$0 self-funded filing (PDF line 4 $112,280 is offset by transfers). Rutgers keeps the Extra Points 3-way split. Louisville keeps the published $200/semester athletic fee plus the FY2025 department total. $0 is printed only when the filing shows $0. Privates and Pittsburgh stay pending. Not added to the capacity stack. Athletic fee ≠ tuition.
